item.title: Nick 5.1.2
item.description:
Nick 5.1.2 — quieter maintenance alerts and clearer recovery

  • Fixes validated Chrome profile ownership and GoogleUpdater maintenance alerts
  • Scopes cloud, installer, simulator and app-update rename activity
  • Clarifies restart recovery and preserves runtime interruption evidence
  • Improves Loom provenance, Git signing context and permission attribution

item.title: Nick 5.1.1
item.description:
Nick 5.1.1 — clearer alerts and more reliable reporting

  • Reduces scoped maintenance and updater false positives
  • Fixes scanner self-blocking and preserves Git signing context
  • Hardens extension reporting against special-file reads
  • Improves menu-bar activation and alert review controls

item.title: Nick 5.1
item.description:
Nick 5.1 — Broader evidence, quieter operation

  • Adds signed protection-intelligence updates with rollback and expiry safeguards
  • Broadens credential, shell-pipeline, persistence, ransomware and file-change evidence
  • Redesigns Settings while preserving existing approvals and controls
  • Improves Endpoint Security delivery, continuity reporting and disk-write efficiency
  • Adds harmless canaries and installed replay tools for transparent local validation

item.title: Nick 5.0
item.description:
Nick 5.0 — Clearer protection, stronger context

  • Adds Simple mode alongside the complete Advanced interface
  • Uses one consistent protection status across every major view
  • Explains responsible apps and command chains for behavior detections
  • Improves download-to-shell and ransomware detection precision
  • Makes remediation safer and failed actions clearer
